<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>mellow by luce | 表参道のヘアサロン</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;1,300;1,400&family=Noto+Sans+JP:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--ivory:#f9f6f1;--cream:#f2ede6;--beige:#e8dfd4;--warm-gray:#b8a99a;--taupe:#8c7b6e;--ink:#2a2420;--gold:#c9a96e;--gold-light:#e8d5b0;--white:#ffffff;--shadow:rgba(42,36,32,0.08)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'Noto Sans JP',sans-serif;background:var(--ivory);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.8}
.page{display:none;min-height:100vh;animation:pageIn 0.6s ease forwards}
.page.active{display:block}
@keyframes pageIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
header{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;padding:0 clamp(20px,5vw,60px);height:70px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;transition:background 0.4s,box-shadow 0.4s}
header.scrolled{background:rgba(249,246,241,0.95);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--beige)}
.logo{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0.08em;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}
.logo span{display:block;font-size:0.55rem;font-family:'Noto Sans JP',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0.25em;color:var(--taupe);font-weight:300;margin-top:2px}
nav{display:flex;gap:clamp(20px,3vw,40px);align-items:center}
nav a{font-size:0.72rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;color:var(--taupe);text-decoration:none;font-weight:400;transition:color 0.3s;cursor:pointer}
nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.nav-reserve{padding:10px 20px;border:1px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:0.68rem!important;transition:all 0.3s!important;background:transparent}
.nav-reserve:hover{background:var(--gold)!important;color:var(--white)!important}
.hamburger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;cursor:pointer;padding:5px}
.hamburger span{width:24px;height:1px;background:var(--ink);display:block}
.mobile-menu{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--ivory);z-index:200;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:40px}
.mobile-menu.open{display:flex;animation:pageIn 0.4s ease}
.mobile-menu a{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2rem;font-weight:300;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.mobile-menu-close{position:absolute;top:25px;right:25px;font-size:1.5rem;cursor:pointer;color:var(--taupe);background:none;border:none}
.hero{height:100vh;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center}
.hero-img{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center 30%;transform:scale(1.05);animation:heroZoom 8s ease forwards}
@keyframes heroZoom{to{transform:scale(1)}}
.hero-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to right,rgba(249,246,241,0.88) 50%,rgba(249,246,241,0.2) 100%)}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:0 clamp(30px,8vw,120px);max-width:700px;animation:heroContent 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1) 0.3s both}
@keyframes heroContent{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.hero-label{font-size:0.65rem;letter-spacing:0.35em;color:var(--gold);font-weight:400;margin-bottom:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.hero-label::before{content:'';display:block;width:40px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
.hero-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(2.8rem,5vw,4.5rem);font-weight:300;line-height:1.25;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:0.02em}
.hero-title em{font-style:italic;color:var(--taupe)}
.hero-subtitle{font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--taupe);letter-spacing:0.1em;line-height:2;margin-bottom:48px;font-weight:300}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn-primary{padding:16px 36px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--ivory);font-size:0.72rem;letter-spacing:0.25em;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Noto Sans JP',sans-serif;transition:all 0.4s;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;display:inline-block}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(201,169,110,0.3)}
.btn-outline{padding:15px 35px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font-size:0.72rem;letter-spacing:0.25em;border:1px solid var(--beige);cursor:pointer;font-family:'Noto Sans JP',sans-serif;transition:all 0.4s;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;display:inline-block}
.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--ink);color:var(--ivory);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.hero-scroll{position:absolute;bottom:40px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--taupe);font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.3em;animation:bounce 2s ease-in-out infinite}
.hero-scroll::after{content:'';width:1px;height:40px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--taupe),transparent);display:block}
@keyframes bounce{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(6px)}}
section{padding:clamp(80px,10vw,140px) clamp(30px,8vw,120px)}
.section-label{font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.4em;color:var(--gold);font-weight:400;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.section-label::before{content:'';width:30px;height:1px;background:var(--gold);display:block}
.section-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:300;line-height:1.2;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:24px;letter-spacing:0.02em}
.section-text{font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--taupe);line-height:2.2;font-weight:300;max-width:480px}
.fade-up{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1),transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)}
.fade-up.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.fade-up.delay-1{transition-delay:0.15s}.fade-up.delay-2{transition-delay:0.3s}.fade-up.delay-3{transition-delay:0.45s}
.two-col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px;align-items:center;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.photo-frame{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.photo-frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;transition:transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)}
.photo-frame:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.photo-frame.portrait{aspect-ratio:3/4}
.photo-frame.landscape{aspect-ratio:4/3}
.photo-frame.square{aspect-ratio:1}
.photo-frame.deco::before{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-16px;right:-16px;width:55%;height:55%;border:1px solid var(--gold-light);z-index:-1}
.gallery-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:2px;max-width:1200px;margin:60px auto 0}
.gallery-item{position:relative;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:3/4;cursor:pointer}
.gallery-item img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;transition:transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)}
.gallery-item:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.gallery-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(42,36,32,0.7) 0%,transparent 50%);opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.4s;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:24px}
.gallery-item:hover .gallery-overlay{opacity:1}
.gallery-label{color:var(--ivory);font-size:0.75rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;font-weight:300}
.interior-trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 0.7fr;gap:3px;max-width:1200px;margin:60px auto 0}
.interior-main-img{overflow:hidden;grid-row:1/3;aspect-ratio:4/3}
.interior-main-img img,.interior-sub-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 0.6s ease}
.interior-main-img:hover img,.interior-sub-img:hover img{transform:scale(1.03)}
.interior-sub-img{overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/3}
.staff-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px;max-width:900px;margin:60px auto 0}
.staff-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}
.staff-img{overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:3/4}
.staff-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;transition:transform 0.6s ease}
.staff-card:hover .staff-img img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.staff-name{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0.1em;color:var(--ink)}
.staff-name small{display:block;font-size:0.62rem;letter-spacing:0.25em;color:var(--gold);font-family:'Noto Sans JP',sans-serif;font-weight:400;margin-bottom:4px}
.staff-desc{font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--taupe);line-height:2;font-weight:300}
.staff-quote{font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--gold);font-weight:300;margin-top:8px;font-style:italic}
.staff-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.staff-tag{font-size:0.62rem;padding:4px 12px;border:1px solid var(--beige);color:var(--taupe)}
.menu-bg{background:var(--cream)}
.menu-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:3px;max-width:1200px;margin:60px auto 0}
.menu-card{background:var(--white);padding:40px 32px;transition:transform 0.3s,box-shadow 0.3s;cursor:pointer}
.menu-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 16px 40px var(--shadow)}
.menu-card-en{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0.1em;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:4px}
.menu-card-jp{font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;color:var(--taupe);margin-bottom:24px;font-weight:300}
.menu-card-price{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:300;color:var(--ink)}
.menu-card-price span{font-family:'Noto Sans JP',sans-serif;font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--taupe);margin-left:4px}
.menu-card-desc{font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--taupe);margin-top:12px;line-height:1.8;font-weight:300}
.menu-card-arrow{margin-top:24px;font-size:0.65rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;color:var(--gold);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.menu-card-arrow::after{content:'';width:20px;height:1px;background:var(--gold);transition:width 0.3s}
.menu-card:hover .menu-card-arrow::after{width:36px}
.reserve-banner{background:var(--cream);padding:100px clamp(30px,8vw,120px);text-align:center;border-top:1px solid var(--beige)}
.reserve-banner .section-label{justify-content:center}
.reserve-banner .section-title{text-align:center}
.reserve-banner .section-text{margin:0 auto 48px;text-align:center}
.reserve-actions{display:flex;gap:16px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn-gold{padding:16px 36px;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ivory);font-size:0.72rem;letter-spacing:0.25em;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Noto Sans JP',sans-serif;transition:all 0.4s;text-decoration:none;display:inline-block}
.btn-gold:hover{background:var(--ink);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-outline-dark{padding:15px 35px;background:transparent;color:var(--taupe);font-size:0.72rem;letter-spacing:0.25em;border:1px solid var(--beige);cursor:pointer;font-family:'Noto Sans JP',sans-serif;transition:all 0.4s;text-decoration:none;display:inline-block}
.btn-outline-dark:hover{border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--ink)}
.sub-hero{height:55vh;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding-bottom:60px;padding-left:clamp(30px,8vw,120px)}
.sub-hero-img{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center}
.sub-hero-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(42,36,32,0.6) 0%,rgba(42,36,32,0.1) 60%)}
.sub-hero-content{position:relative;z-index:2}
.sub-hero-content .section-label{color:rgba(232,213,176,0.8)}.sub-hero-content .section-label::before{background:rgba(232,213,176,0.8)}
.sub-hero-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5vw,4rem);font-weight:300;letter-spacing:0.05em;line-height:1.1;color:var(--ivory)}
.menu-section{padding:80px clamp(30px,8vw,120px);max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.menu-category{margin-bottom:60px;padding-bottom:60px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--beige)}
.menu-category:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.menu-category-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:0.1em;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:4px}
.menu-category-jp{font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;color:var(--taupe);margin-bottom:32px;font-weight:300}
.menu-items{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.menu-item{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--cream);gap:20px}
.menu-item-name{font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--ink);font-weight:300}
.menu-item-price{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--taupe);white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
.menu-note{font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--warm-gray);margin-top:16px;line-height:2;font-weight:300}
.access-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px;align-items:start;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:80px clamp(30px,8vw,120px)}
.access-map{background:var(--beige);position:relative;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/3}
.access-map img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.access-info-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:300;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:32px}
.access-block{margin-bottom:28px;padding-bottom:28px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--cream)}
.access-block:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.access-block-label{font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.3em;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:8px}
.access-block-value{font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--ink);line-height:2;font-weight:300}
.faq-container{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:80px clamp(30px,8vw,60px)}
.faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--beige)}
.faq-q{padding:24px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.88rem;color:var(--ink);gap:20px}
.faq-icon{width:28px;height:28px;border:1px solid var(--beige);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.1rem;flex-shrink:0;transition:all 0.3s}
.faq-item.open .faq-icon{background:var(--gold);color:var(--white);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.faq-a{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height 0.4s ease,padding 0.4s ease;font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--taupe);line-height:2;font-weight:300}
.faq-item.open .faq-a{max-height:300px;padding-bottom:24px}
.flow-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:40px;max-width:1100px;margin:60px auto 0}
.flow-step{text-align:center;position:relative}
.flow-step::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:24px;right:-20px;width:40px;height:1px;background:var(--beige)}
.flow-step:last-child::after{display:none}
.flow-num{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2.5rem;font-weight:300;color:var(--gold);line-height:1;margin-bottom:16px}
.flow-title{font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:0.1em}
.flow-desc{font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--taupe);line-height:1.9;font-weight:300}
.policy-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:3px;max-width:1200px;margin:60px auto 0}
.policy-card{background:var(--white);padding:48px 40px}
.policy-num{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:3rem;font-weight:300;color:var(--gold-light);line-height:1;margin-bottom:20px}
.policy-title{font-size:0.88rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:12px}
.policy-desc{font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--taupe);line-height:2;font-weight:300}
.salon-trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:3px;max-width:1200px;margin:60px auto 0}
.salon-item{overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/3;cursor:pointer}
.salon-item img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 0.5s ease}
.salon-item:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
footer{background:var(--ink);padding:80px clamp(30px,8vw,120px) 40px;color:var(--warm-gray)}
.footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:60px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto 60px}
.footer-brand .logo{color:var(--ivory)}.footer-brand .logo span{color:var(--warm-gray)}
.footer-tagline{font-size:0.75rem;line-height:2;margin-top:20px;font-weight:300}
.footer-col-title{font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.3em;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:20px}
.footer-col a{display:block;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--warm-gray);text-decoration:none;margin-bottom:12px;transition:color 0.3s;cursor:pointer;font-weight:300}
.footer-col a:hover{color:var(--ivory)}
.footer-info{font-size:0.75rem;line-height:2;font-weight:300}
.footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);padding-top:30px;text-align:center;font-size:0.65rem;color:rgba(184,169,154,0.5);letter-spacing:0.1em;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.mobile-cta{display:none;position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:50;background:var(--ivory);border-top:1px solid var(--beige);padding:12px 20px;gap:10px}
.mobile-cta a{flex:1;padding:14px;text-align:center;font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.mobile-cta a:first-child{background:var(--ink);color:var(--ivory)}
.mobile-cta a:last-child{background:transparent;color:var(--taupe);border:1px solid var(--beige)}
@media(max-width:1024px){.menu-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px}.gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.flow-steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.flow-step::after{display:none}}
@media(max-width:768px){nav{display:none}.hamburger{display:flex}.two-col,.access-grid,.staff-grid,.policy-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}.menu-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.menu-items{grid-template-columns:1fr}.footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}.mobile-cta{display:flex}body{padding-bottom:60px}.interior-trio{grid-template-columns:1fr}.salon-trio{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:480px){.gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.flow-steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}.salon-trio{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="mobile-menu" id="mobileMenu">
  <button class="mobile-menu-close" onclick="closeMobileMenu()">✕</button>
  <a onclick="showPage('home');closeMobileMenu()">Home</a>
  <a onclick="showPage('concept');closeMobileMenu()">Concept</a>
  <a onclick="showPage('menu');closeMobileMenu()">Menu</a>
  <a onclick="showPage('staff');closeMobileMenu()">Staff</a>
  <a onclick="showPage('salon');closeMobileMenu()">Salon</a>
  <a onclick="showPage('style');closeMobileMenu()">Style</a>
  <a onclick="showPage('first');closeMobileMenu()">First Visit</a>
  <a onclick="showPage('access');closeMobileMenu()">Access</a>
  <a onclick="showPage('faq');closeMobileMenu()">FAQ</a>
</div>
<header id="header">
  <a class="logo" onclick="showPage('home')" style="cursor:pointer">mellow by luce<span>OMOTESANDO HAIR SALON</span></a>
  <nav>
    <a onclick="showPage('concept')">Concept</a>
    <a onclick="showPage('menu')">Menu</a>
    <a onclick="showPage('staff')">Staff</a>
    <a onclick="showPage('salon')">Salon</a>
    <a onclick="showPage('first')">First Visit</a>
    <a onclick="showPage('access')">Access</a>
    <a class="nav-reserve" onclick="showPage('reserve')">Reserve</a>
  </nav>
  <div class="hamburger" onclick="openMobileMenu()"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
</header>

<div class="page active" id="page-home">
<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-img" style="background-image:url('data:image/webp;base64,')"></div>
  <div class="hero-overlay"></div>
  <div class="hero-content">
    <div class="hero-label">OMOTESANDO HAIR SALON</div>
    <h1 class="hero-title">やわらかく、<em>上品に。</em><br>毎日に自然と<br>なじむ髪へ。</h1>
    <p class="hero-subtitle">ショート・ボブ・ミディアムを中心に、<br>扱いやすさとやわらかな質感を大切にした<br>プライベート感のあるヘアサロン</p>
    <div class="hero-actions">
      <a class="btn-primary" onclick="showPage('reserve')">WEB予約はこちら</a>
      <a class="btn-outline" onclick="showPage('menu')">メニューを見る</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-scroll">SCROLL</div>
</section>

<!-- Concept intro -->
<section style="background:var(--ivory)">
  <div class="two-col">
    <div class="photo-frame portrait deco fade-up">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="ロングスタイル">
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="section-label fade-up">Concept</div>

      <div class="section-label fade-up">Philosophy</div>
      <h2 class="section-title fade-up delay-1">大きく変えすぎなくても、<br>気持ちは少し<br>軽くなります。</h2>
      <p class="section-text fade-up delay-2">mellow by luceが大切にしているのは、肩の力を抜いて過ごせる、自然で上品なヘア。<br><br>やわらかな光が入る落ち着いた空間で、一人ひとりの髪の状態と理想を丁寧に伺いながら、無理のない、長く楽しめるスタイルをご提案します。</p>
    </div>

</section>

  </div>
  <div class="policy-grid">
    <div class="policy-card fade-up"><div class="policy-num">01</div><div class="policy-title">扱いやすさを大切にしたカット</div><p class="policy-desc">乾かしただけでもまとまりやすく、毎日のスタイリングが少し楽になるように。骨格や毛流れを見ながら、自然に馴染むシルエットに整えます。</p></div>
    <div class="policy-card fade-up delay-1"><div class="policy-num">02</div><div class="policy-title">やわらかく見える質感づくり</div><p class="policy-desc">軽すぎず、重すぎず。毛先の動きや表面のやわらかさを大切にしながら、上品に見える質感をつくります。</p></div>
    <div class="policy-card fade-up delay-2"><div class="policy-num">03</div><div class="policy-title">初めての方でも相談しやすい空間</div><p class="policy-desc">「似合う髪型が分からない」「短くしたいけれど不安がある」そんなご相談も歓迎しています。カウンセリングの時間を大切にしながら、無理のないご提案を行います。</p></div>
    <div class="policy-card fade-up delay-3"><div class="policy-num">04</div><div class="policy-title">落ち着いて過ごせる店内</div><p class="policy-desc">明るくやわらかな光が入る空間で、ゆったりとお過ごしいただけます。シャンプーブースも落ち着いた雰囲気で、リラックスしやすい設計です。</p></div>

<script>
const header=document.getElementById('header');
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
  if(window.scrollY>60)header.classList.add('scrolled');
  else header.classList.remove('scrolled');
});
function showPage(id){
  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
  const t=document.getElementById('page-'+id);
  if(t){t.classList.add('active');window.scrollTo(0,0);setTimeout(initFadeUps,100);}
}
function openMobileMenu(){document.getElementById('mobileMenu').classList.add('open');}
function closeMobileMenu(){document.getElementById('mobileMenu').classList.remove('open');}
function toggleFaq(el){
  const item=el.parentElement;
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item.open').forEach(i=>{if(i!==item)i.classList.remove('open');});
  item.classList.toggle('open');
}
function initFadeUps(){
  const els=document.querySelectorAll('.page.active .fade-up:not(.visible)');
  const io=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');io.unobserve(e.target);}});
  },{threshold:0.08,rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px 0px'});
  els.forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
}
initFadeUps();
</script>
